row.specification: At index i, return the sum of left_values[0] through left_values[i], inclusive, accumulated in increasing index order.

interfaceContract.dispatch: One logical element per global_invocation_id.x. Guard i>=params.length. Store only output_values[params.output_offset+i]. Preserve all input buffers and output padding.

row.prompt:
Return only WGSL statements defining a local f32 variable named value. No Markdown, declarations of bindings, entrypoint, or function. Available: i:u32, params.length:u32, x:f32 (left_values[i]), y:f32 (right_values[i]), and left_values:array<f32>. WGSL syntax reminder (not an answer): mutable locals use var, such as var total: f32 = 0.0; a loop has parentheses, such as for (var j = 0u; j < limit; j += 1u) { /* statements */ }. Do not use Rust range loops or a trailing bare expression. Use loops when needed. Task:
<specification>
At index i, return the sum of left_values[0] through left_values[i], inclusive, accumulated in increasing index order.
</specification>
